scopeNote: This page has exactly ONE template and ONE route, so this graph's job is not to referee many possible compositions — it is to pin the one real composition and reject drift away from it. Every rule below was checked against templates/templates.json's actual node sequence at the time it was written.

EXPECTED_CATEGORY_SEQUENCE.statement: The rendered category sequence is fixed. Note this is the EXPANDED instance order: chrome.page-separator is listed once in templates.json but renders 4 times, before demo.radix, demo.security-cards, demo.complete-diagram and proof.testimonials, so the real instance is 21 nodes rather than the template's 18.
EXPECTED_CATEGORY_SEQUENCE.rationale: A single-route site has one correct order; a reordering is drift, not a variant.

NO_ADJACENT_SAME_CATEGORY_DOES_NOT_APPLY.statement: The conventional NO_ADJACENT_SAME_CATEGORY rhythm rule is NOT enforced here, because the real page violates it everywhere by design: 2 consecutive CHROME nodes, 5 consecutive HERO nodes, 3 consecutive PRODUCT_DEMO nodes, then 3 more, then 2 consecutive CONVERSION nodes. A rule with exceptions covering every run in the document would be vacuous. EXPECTED_CATEGORY_SEQUENCE carries the real constraint instead.

ONE_HERO_DOES_NOT_APPLY.statement: There is no single 'hero' section on this site to be unique. The hero is a COMPOSITE of 5 HERO-category nodes plus 2 CHROME nodes, all living inside one React component and one CSS grid. A classic ONE_HERO rule would have nothing to count. HERO_NODE_SET_COMPLETE carries the real constraint.

HERO_NODE_SET_COMPLETE.statement: All 5 HERO-category nodes must be present exactly once each, and all must appear before capability.feature-strip.
HERO_NODE_SET_COMPLETE.rationale: They are facets of one grid; omitting one leaves a hole in the hero's 14-row template.

HAIRLINE_GRID_FIRST.statement: chrome.hairline-grid must be the first node. The grid is declared before anything placed into it.

HEADER_IMMEDIATELY_AFTER_GRID.statement: chrome.hero-header must be node 1, immediately after chrome.hairline-grid.
HEADER_IMMEDIATELY_AFTER_GRID.note: The header is the first node carrying content, but it is NOT first — see HAIRLINE_GRID_FIRST.

CTA_BOXES_LAST.statement: conversion.cta-boxes must be the last node. There is no footer to follow it.
CTA_BOXES_LAST.exception: None. This template has no footer section, because the site has no <footer> element at all.

CTA_HEADER_IMMEDIATELY_PRECEDES_BOXES.statement: conversion.cta-header must appear exactly once, immediately before conversion.cta-boxes.

PICKERS_IMMEDIATELY_FOLLOW_BROWSER.statement: demo.customiser-pickers must appear exactly once, immediately after demo.custom-ui-browser, because the browser frame physically hosts the pickers and the two cannot be separated.

SEPARATOR_PLACEMENT.statement: chrome.page-separator is the only repeatable node. It occurs exactly 4 times, before demo.radix, demo.security-cards, demo.complete-diagram and proof.testimonials — 4 of the 8 section boundaries. It MUST NOT be added at the other four boundaries, and the rhythm MUST NOT be regularised.

NO_NAV_NO_FOOTER.statement: No navigation and no footer section may be added. The real site has no <nav> and no <footer> element at all, and its header is position:static with zero scroll behaviour.
NO_NAV_NO_FOOTER.rationale: Absence of site chrome is a measured structural fact here, not an omission to be helpfully filled in.

SINGLE_ROUTE_SINGLE_TEMPLATE.statement: Exactly one route (/) bound to exactly one template. No route or template may be invented: 15 probed candidate routes on the original all return 404 and only / returns 200.

SCROLL_SCRUB_BUDGET.statement: Exactly two scroll-scrubbed systems exist on this page: the hero's CENTRE auth card and the demo.radix logo stack. No other node may declare trigger scroll-scrub.
SCROLL_SCRUB_BUDGET.supersedes: CLONE_SPEC 3.4 claims there is no scroll-linked (scrubbed) animation anywhere. That is wrong; this rule records the two real systems.

NO_CONSECUTIVE_SCROLL_SCRUB.statement: The two scrubbed systems must not be adjacent nodes — two competing rAF scrub loops in one viewport is the one motion-budget failure this page's composition avoids.

INTERACTIVITY_BUDGET.statement: Exactly two nodes are genuinely interactive: hero.light-switch and demo.customiser-pickers. The other five PRODUCT_DEMO nodes are observer- or mount-triggered animation with NO user input. A generator must not add interactivity to them.

REDUCED_MOTION_FALLBACK_REQUIRED.statement: Every node's motion object must declare a reducedMotionFallback. The clone goes beyond the original here deliberately: the original guards only .spotlight, while the clone adds a global duration clamp AND every JS loop checks prefersReducedMotion() itself.

MOTION_FREE_NODES.statement: Exactly three nodes are entirely motion-free and must stay that way: chrome.page-separator, proof.testimonials and conversion.cta-header. proof.testimonials is the only fully static content section on the page.

ONE_AUTH_CARD_IMPLEMENTATION.statement: All four auth-card instances (3 in the hero, 1 as the customiser target) must resolve to the ONE shared component.auth-card contract. Forking the card, or adding a second login-card component, is forbidden — this is a user directive, not an incidental convenience.

NO_LIGHT_MODE_FORK.statement: Light appearance is a `.light` ancestor class cascade plus custom properties. There are deliberately NO forked `-light` primitives, components or sections. A generated node expresses light appearance only as theme 'light', and only on a section whose contract sets supportsLightSubtree true.

ALL_OUTBOUND_HREFS_INERT.statement: HARD CONSTRAINT by explicit user instruction. Every off-domain destination resolves to the inert href '#'. A generated instance must not emit an absolute or external URL anywhere. This is not a defect to repair.

NO_EXTERNAL_ASSET_REQUESTS.statement: Every asset must resolve to a local path. Fonts are self-hosted. No Google Fonts, no CDN, no third-party request. The clone runs fully offline.

SHARED_ONCE_STRUCTURE.statement: A user directive about where things may be defined: shared UI lives only in the primitives module, every icon only in the icons module, design tokens only in tailwind.config.js, and all 29 @keyframes plus both glow primitives only in src/index.css. A generated contract must not introduce a second home for any of these.
SHARED_ONCE_STRUCTURE.verifiedKeyframeLocation: 29 @keyframes in src/index.css; 0 in every src/styles/*.css (verified by grep -c)

NO_DOCUMENT_HEIGHT_CONTRACT.statement: Document height must NOT be recorded as a contract or fidelity value anywhere. Six sections use content-visibility:auto, so scrollHeight varies per measurement pass on BOTH the clone and the original. CLONE_SPEC's 6484 figure was a mid-expansion capture.

ASSET_ROLE_CLOSED.statement: Every media field must carry an assetRole drawn from the closed vocabulary in assets/asset-roles.json. Bare generic strings like 'image' or 'src' are rejected. Five roles are pinned to one specific generationPolicy value and may not be changed even to another valid enum member.

NO_REAL_ENTITY_CONTENT.statement: COMPLIANCE-CRITICAL. A generated instance must not reproduce or fabricate a real company's logo, a real identifiable person's photograph or likeness, a real person's name attached to a quote, or real proprietary marketing copy. Generated instances get original placeholder assets and original copy. This design-repo stores copy BUDGETS (character and line counts) rather than the text itself for exactly this reason.

PRESERVE_INTENTIONAL_UPSTREAM_BUG.statement: The hero's two auto-placing vertical lines are a REPRODUCED upstream bug, not a defect. The stylesheet declares grid areas vs-line-1/vs-line-2 while the DOM writes v-line-5/v-line-6, so those two elements auto-place. A generator must not 'fix' it.

MOTION_EVIDENCE_HONESTY.statement: Two motion values are inferences rather than measurements and must keep their honest evidence level: the RBAC card's exit-leg rate (0.105/frame) and the unmeasured trigger of the unused .anim2 RBAC mask variant. Neither may be promoted to 'measured', and no trigger may be invented for .anim2.
